name: FRSMiniMap
author: Chrystian Farias
description: A 3D minimap and an expanded map on M, with the career events, the GPS route and the other racers.

settings.label: Theme
settings.description: The map's colours and markers. Original is the game's own map; the other themes (and Clean map) need the full package, with the map layers

settings.label: Clean map
settings.description: Only the roads over the game (in a race, only the track): no ground, water or relief, and no outline on a solid edge

settings.label: 3D buildings
settings.description: The city's buildings standing up on the minimap, lit so their sides can be told apart

settings.label: Shape
settings.description: Round, or rectangular as GTA V's

settings.label: Edge
settings.description: Infinite: the map fades out at the edges. Solid: a clear border with an outline

settings.label: Size
settings.description: The minimap's size. It already follows the screen resolution; this scales it further

settings.label: Left margin
settings.description: Distance from the left edge of the screen (pixels at 1080p, scaled with the resolution)

settings.label: Bottom margin
settings.description: Distance from the bottom edge of the screen (pixels at 1080p, scaled with the resolution)

settings.label: Icons
settings.description: Pins with the mod's icons and colours, or the game's own circles and colours

settings.label: Turn with
settings.description: The map turns with the camera (as in GTA) or with the car

settings.label: Dynamic zoom
settings.description: The zoom opens up with speed, down to a limit

settings.label: Route in the event's colour
settings.description: The GPS route takes the colour of its destination's marker instead of the light blue

settings.label: Blue GPS arrow
settings.description: The blue marker that floats ahead of the car while the GPS has a route
